headline: US Prepares New Tariffs Targeting Industrial Overcapacity in China and EU
summary: The US government plans to announce new import tariffs targeting China, the European Union, and more than a dozen other economies. The levies address alleged industrial overcapacity and state subsidies for domestic manufacturers.
why: US tariff policies impact international trade flows, corporate supply chains, and global inflation dynamics.

impacts.name: China
impacts.why: US tariffs target Chinese manufacturing overcapacity and subsidies.
